reviews.comment: She cancelled our first two classes on the first week. Friday class wasn't cancelled so we all stayed just for her to not show up in the first 20 minutes. I have no idea what she's actually like as a prof but she was wasting my time so I dropped class.

I feel bad saying this because she was so sweet, but I hated this class. The exams are incredibly hard, everyone in my class struggled, and the content just isn't well organized; she is not tech savvy. But she is kind to us and is passionate about what she does.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren is a decent person.  But she cancels class often, does not respond to email, and fails to post grades on- line.  She is unorganized, and rambles unnecessarily during lectures.  I would not recommend taking her classes at all.

Cancels class almost every day- manageable for a lower-level ENGL course if you keep up with teaching yourself, but absolutely do not take her for a senior seminar. Nice lady but extremely unorganized. She commutes to campus from Houston and is often late if class isn't canceled. All her grades are quizzes and tests- strange for an ENGL class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Avoid. Sweet lady but class was difficult for no reason. Hours of reading daily. 10+ books read in the sem (which u have to pay for). No rubric for assignments. 10 questions over 3 books in 1 quiz. Cancels class every week, seems great but u have no idea whats going on in class & she grades hard. Never made below an A+ in an engl course & got a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren's class was very lecture heavy, but it the readings very clear. There are a lot of reading assignments, but, you'll do fine in the class if you keep up. It's an English class, so you're going to have to read. It's not a blow off class. She's passionate about her work and it shows in her lectures and feedback on your work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Warren wasn't too bad, though I don't know if I'd take her class again. She was friendly and knowledgeable but a bit disorganized and sometimes assignment expectations weren't super clear. If you take her, be ready to read, take good notes, and get good feedback. And ask lots of questions!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is passionate about what she teaches, but she cancelled class once a week. That was great until the material we missed because of that was on the exam. There's only 2 papers, but they are pretty long and over a short prompt. It is completely dependent on you reading the books, because she doesn't really teach the material at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very sweet lady, but this class is a chore. You have to purchase several books, it is a reading-heavy course, she hardly ever responds to emails, does not keep up with putting grades into Canvas, & sometimes posts assignments very last minute & expects them to be done on time. You do have to read the material & attend lecture to pass the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren is amazing and it makes me sad to see she is getting negative reviews simply because she makes you work for your grade. There is a lot of reading, but I used Sparknotes for a lot of it and did fine. The tests are written, but everything on the exams are things or passages covered in class so highlight and take notes on what she says.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is really reading heavy, but the readings themselves weren't hard. There are two take home tests that are kind of a pain but doable. I had her online this semester and we didn't have any lectures or anything, it was literally just reading books and writing discussion posts/essays. Not my favorite class, but not bad either.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: You have to buy about 6 books that will be read during the semester and the number of assigned pages was A LOT per week. Dr. Warren would rarely reply to emails, put in grades, or upload assignments that would be due the next morning. Instructions for papers were vague, you're on your own in this class and the lack of communication is frustrating.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr Warrens class was really heavy on reading, but shes a fantastic professor and so clearly is passionate about the topic, and shes very easy to talk to. She usually is understanding if you need help or extensions on papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren is a fine professor. My main issues with the class were that you were graded by a few things and there was so much reading it was difficult to keep up with. She also tests over the literature two or three times during the semester. It is not a multiple choice test and it was completely comprised of essayed questions and definitions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a very nice lady but honestly the expectations she has regarding readings are completely unreasonable for a 3 hour class. If you enjoy hundreds (and hundreds) of pages of medieval literature and going over the same themes again and again and again, take this class. If not, avoid. There's no textbook so you HAVE to get all info from lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you're taking this class for your literature credit, get ready to work harder than you do in classes for your actual major. Even as someone who excels in english oriented courses, I really struggled to keep up with the amount of studying and the amount of work required to make an A. It's not an easy A course, and to me it wasn't worth it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: There's a ton of books to buy and you read all of them plus more that she puts on eCampus. If you don't read you won't pass the tests. She does give a pretty good amount of extra credit though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a great professor with clear instructions and expectations. The tests are very lecture heavy and the readings can be excessive at times, but she only tests over the quotes she discusses in class. There are only 3 tests and one paper that make up your grade, but she offers some extra credit throughout the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: TONS OF READINGS. In old and middle English I might add, which make it near impossible to read. Not only are the texts hard to read, they are uninteresting. I found this class very time consuming and hard. There are only three tests, so each test is packed full of readings, making it extremely hard to study and do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This course had a lot of readings each week, and the lectures were very bland. The tests were completely free response, and they were long and hard. If you don't study (for a really good amount of time) and literally memorize text passages she goes over in class, you will not do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Your expected to read a lot of books that are quiet difficult to understand and the amount you are expected to read before each class can be overwhelming. There are pop quizzes to be cautious of and there are two very long papers you are expected to write. Professor Warren herself is compassionate about what she teaches so class is rarely boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Yeah, it's a lit class, but it was the worst. She expects us to read Old English and the class was completely irrelevant to the modern world. What a waste. She explains why A&M's English department is awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you cant read Old English dont take her medieval literature course. Get ready for absurd essays, copious amounts of reading (in Old English), and boring lectures. I will say shes passionate about her job and field of study, and shes willing to help, but do not take one of her courses unless youre in that specific field of study.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you aren't the least bit interested in women's studies or medieval literature, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS however, if those are topics that interest you she makes the material very interesting and is helpful in and outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Warren as a human but the class wasn't my favorite, simply because I didn't like the reading material - which was a lot of medieval crap. The tests were really tough and took a lot of studying but if you do the readings and go to class, you should be fine. Dr. Warren is also really helpful and I could tell she loved the subject.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: It's an English class, so I expected to read a lot. What I did not expect was for the final test to be over thirteen texts that we had to basically memorize in order to do okay on the test. The final was one of the hardest tests I've ever taken (I'm a 4.0 senior) because there was no clarity about what would be on there and no time to complete it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This class focused on medieval literature which was incredibly difficult to read and she assigned about 50-100 pages per class. It was near impossible to keep up with the readings which made the tests pretty stressful. She's really nice though and enthusiastic about what she teaches. The class is less lecture and more group discussions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: If you're into medieval literature and don't mind reading about saint's lives or other religious topics, don't hesitate to enroll. If not, the reading material may be difficult to digest which will mean you have to read pretty intensely for this course. Dr. Warren is definitely willing to work with you, though!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you don't like english, reading, or old material. Do. Not. Take. This. Course. But! If you do, then it was a great class! She's extremely enthusiastic about this subject which helps but it's quite a bit of reading. She's a fairly lenient grader and if you put forward effort, she rewards you.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren is an awesome professor! She is super friendly, makes lectures fun and really cares about her students. She is super accessible outside of class and is always willing to give helpful feedback. It's an English class, so get ready to read!! Two tests, five pop quizzes, and one paper. Loved her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
